name: Is bathtub removal a DIY project or should I hire a general contractor?

mainEntity.name: Is bathtub removal a DIY project or should I hire a general contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: While a handy homeowner can theoretically demo a fiberglass tub, hiring a professional contractor prevents costly damage to hidden plumbing, electrical lines, and subfloor framing. Bathtub removal involves shutting off water lines, capping supplies, disconnecting trap assemblies, and maneuvering heavy materials through finished hallways without gouging drywall or trim. Working with a hands-on general contractor ensures that plumbing connections are safely handled by qualified trades, and any rotted subfloors or mold discovered behind the surround are addressed immediately by an experienced carpentry team.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hiring a contractor is safer because tub removal involves plumbing disconnects, heavy lifting, and potential structural repairs to wall framing and subfloors.
